'''Bammy Decree''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] during the time of [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. He owned an [[Bammy Decree's apartment|apartment]] located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and was an associate of [[Invisible Market]] dealer [[Zegundis]].<ref name="Wolf">{{StoryCite|story=Lone Wolf: A Tale of Obi-Wan and Luke|book=SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story}}</ref>

Keeping the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] in orbit over the moon,<ref name="Wolf" /> he fixed up the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']] for the local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], [[Rej Taunt]]. While working on it he found the [[SuperFlow IV/Legends|SuperFlow IV]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]] and made a short history of the previous owners of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]].

In [[43 ABY]] he was met by [[Tobb Jadak]] and [[Flitcher Poste]], they asked what he knew of the ''Stellar Envoy'' and if he knew who currently owned it.
He owned a garage in the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] sector where he repaired the ''Stellar Envoy'' after it crashed into the ''[[Jendirian Valley III]]'' because of damage it had sustained from Republic weapons fire.
